```lean
Ne.{u} {α : Sort u} (a b : α) : Prop
```
***
`a ≠ b`, or `Ne a b` is defined as `¬ (a = b)` or `a = b → False`,
and asserts that `a` and `b` are not equal.

```lean
Filter.Frequently.{u} {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (f : Filter α) : Prop
```
***
`f.Frequently p` or `∃ᶠ x in f, p x` mean that `{x | ¬p x} ∉ f`. E.g., `∃ᶠ x in atTop, p x`
means that there exist arbitrarily large `x` for which `p` holds true. 
***
*import Mathlib.Order.Filter.Basic*

```lean
Nat.ModEq (n a b : ℕ) : Prop
```
***
Modular equality. `n.ModEq a b`, or `a ≡ b [MOD n]`, means that `a - b` is a multiple of `n`. 
***
*import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq*

```lean
Filter.atTop.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [Preorder α] : Filter α
```
***
`atTop` is the filter representing the limit `→ ∞` on an ordered set.
It is generated by the collection of up-sets `{b | a ≤ b}`.
(The preorder need not have a top element for this to be well defined,
and indeed is trivial when a top element exists.)
